title: SIDESTORY: WHEN ELEGIES ARE ASHES OPEN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: WHEN ELEGIES ARE ASHES OPEN
DURATION: August 28, 2025, 10:00 – September 18, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: When Elegies Are Ashes event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
Phase 1 [Flickering Shadows]
DURATION: August 28, 2025, 10:00 – September 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Phase 2 [Dying Flames]
DURATION: September 4, 2025, 16:00 – September 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Griefs yet to Relieve]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Griefs yet to Relieve] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Brigid], 'Night of Na Saoirsí' Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, [Broken Originium Lamp], etc.
[ Lives Yet to Begin ]
DURATION: August 28, 2025, 10:00 – September 18, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Broken Originium Lamp] by clearing event stages and completing [Griefs yet to Relieve] missions. [Broken Originium Lamp] can be used to redeem items from [Lives Yet to Begin]. REWARDS: Brigid's token, 'Night of Na Saoirsí' Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Coral Coast - Holiday HD31 for Warfarin, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
- During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – RETURNED FROM A PYRE
DURATION: August 28, 2025, 10:00 – September 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Returned From A Pyre], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Necrass
★★★★★: Wulfenite / Mitm

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Necrass
★★★★★: Wulfenite / Brigid
Note:
Operator Brigid is currently ONLY available from the When Elegies Are Ashes event, and is NOT available in [Returned From A Pyre] headhunting or any [Standard Headhunting] and [Kernel Headhunting].
Necrass and Wulfenite will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after September 11, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
Necrass, Wulfenite, and Brigid will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 NEW SELECTION MECHANISM IN PERMANENT STANDARD HEADHUNTING & KERNEL HEADHUNTING
DETAILS: After the patch update on August 28, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7), the Selection mechanism will be applied to permanent Standard Headhunting and Kernel Headhunting.

Standard Selection: In the current [Standard Headhunting], after a total of 150 headhunting attempts, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be one of the currently rate-up 6-star Operators (limited to 1 time). After a total of 300 headhunting attempts, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be the other currently rate-up 6-star Operator (limited to 1 time). The count of headhunting attempts for [Standard Selection] will be cleared at the end of the current [Standard Headhunting].

Kernel Selection: In the current [Kernel Headhunting], after a total of 150 headhunting attempts, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be one of the currently rate-up 6-star Operators (limited to 1 time). After a total of 300 headhunting attempts, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the other currently rate-up 6-star Operator (limited to 1 time). The count of headhunting attempts for [Kernel Selection] will be cleared at the end of the current [Kernel Headhunting].

Meanwhile, the permanent Standard Headhunting and Kernel Headhunting interfaces will display the cumulative number of headhunting attempts, along with corresponding prompts once the Selection mechanism is triggered.
Note:
The Selection mechanism will first be applied to the permanent Standard Headhunting opening on August 29, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7) and the Kernel Headhunting opening on September 9, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
05 EPOQUE & ACHIEVEMENT STAR COLLECTIONS NEW ARRIVALS AT THE OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: August 28, 2025, 10:00 – September 18, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Sweetness to the Heart for Nymph
EPOQUE Collection - Midskog Fika for Valarqvin
EPOQUE Collection - Plush Cake for Dur-nar
Achievement Star Collection - To Evoke the Anima for Sesa
06 NEW FURNITURE SET – 'NIGHT OF NA SAOIRSÍ'
DETAILS: Brand new set of themed furniture, 'Night of Na Saoirsí' will be available.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
When Elegies Are Ashes event rewards and redeemable (Pieces)
Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces)
DURATION: August 28, 2025, 10:00 – September 11, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
07 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DURATION: August 28, 2025, 10:00 – September 18, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available at the Store for a limited time.
[CASTER CHIP PACK]
CONTENTS: Caster Dualchip * 4, Caster Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
[FURNACESIDE FABLES TRAINING PACK]
CONTENTS: Top Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1, Professional Operator Training Invitation Letter * 2

Top Operator Training Invitation Letter: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has not yet been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 1. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.
08 NEW REDEEMABLES AVAILABLE IN [DISTINCTIONS] AND [UNIVERSAL CERTIFICATES EXCHANGE AREA]
UPDATE TIME: August 28, 2025, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: New redeemables in [Distinctions] and [Universal Certificates Exchange Area]:
0011 Productions - Healing Hand, Evil Heart for Aak
EPOQUE Collection - Unknown Journey for Gitano
Please stay tuned for more information!
